title: JRN-007 Exception Path: Credit Decline — Risk Rating Too High
description: Exception path where the automated credit scoring returns a high risk rating (risk_rating = 8) mandating credit committee referral. The credit committee reviews the credit paper and declines based on insufficient DSCR and unsecured exposure above appetite. EVT-035 (LoanDeclined) is published. No FacilityAgreement or LoanAccount is created. Journey terminates at PH-019.
decline_trigger: risk_rating = 8 (above acceptable threshold for this exposure class and amount). DSCR = 0.98 (below minimum 1.25). Facility unsecured with no acceptable collateral. Combined with sector risk (construction sector, SIC 41202) above concentration limit.

steps.description: PH-016/PH-017: Loan Enquiry and Application — same as happy path

steps.label:
Submits formal application
(£750,000 unsecured, construction sector)

Creates ENT-017 (LoanApplication)
status = submitted
EVT-031: LoanApplicationSubmitted

EVT-032: CreditAssessmentRequested
[CROSS-CAPABILITY: CAP-002 → CAP-004]

steps.description: PH-018: Credit Assessment — automated scoring returns HIGH risk rating

steps.label:
Delivers EVT-032 to SVC-012
[◀ CROSS-CAPABILITY]

Runs IRB models on £750k unsecured
construction sector exposure:
risk_rating=8 (HIGH — triggers mandatory committee)
pd_score=0.0780 (7.8% PD)
lgd_estimate=0.45 (unsecured floor)
ead=750000
ecl_provision=26325.00
ifrs9_stage=stage_1 (at origination)

EVT-033: CreditAssessmentCompleted
{risk_rating: 8, pd_score: 0.0780,
lgd: 0.45, ecl: 26325.00}
[CROSS-CAPABILITY: CAP-004 → CAP-002]
Delivers EVT-033 to SVC-005

Stores assessment_id
risk_rating=8 → MANDATORY credit
committee referral flag set
Routes to Credit Analyst

Assigns to Credit Analyst
Flagged: mandatory committee referral
(risk_rating >= 8)
Reads ENT-018 automated scores

Prepares credit paper:
DSCR = 0.98 (FAILS minimum 1.25)
Net Leverage = 4.2x (above 3.0x appetite)
Construction sector: above concentration limit
Recommendation: DECLINE

Presents credit paper to
credit committee

steps.description: PH-019: Underwriting — Credit Committee Review and Decline

steps.label:
Deliberates on credit paper:
1. DSCR 0.98 < 1.25 minimum (FAIL)
2. Unsecured £750k above RM appetite
3. Construction sector concentration exceeded
4. pd_score 7.8% above sector policy limit
Decision: DECLINE

Committee records DECLINE
decline_reasons: [insufficient_dscr,
unsecured_above_appetite,
sector_concentration_limit]

Records committee decision:
committee_decision = declined
decline_reasons array populated

Updates LoanApplication.status = declined
CreditAssessment.committee_decision = declined
(via SVC-012 API)
No FacilityAgreement created
No LoanAccount created

EVT-035: LoanDeclined
{application_id, assessment_id,
decision: declined,
decline_reasons: [insufficient_dscr,
unsecured_above_appetite,
sector_concentration_limit],
risk_rating: 8}

Delivers EVT-035
→ SVC-053 sends formal decline letter
to PER-002 with:
- Decline reasons
- Right of appeal
- BBRS signposting (GOV-002-R03)
- FCA SME disclosure (GOV-002-R05)

Formal decline letter delivered:
'We are unable to approve your application
for the following reasons: [decline_reasons].
You have the right to appeal this decision.
For SME dispute resolution, please contact BBRS
(Business Banking Resolution Service) if your
annual turnover is below £10m.'

NOTE: Journey terminates here.
No PH-020 (FacilityAgreement)
No PH-021 (Drawdown)
No PH-022 (Monitoring)

steps.description: Optional: RM may discuss alternative structures with PER-002 — smaller amount, additional security, or different product. If alternative proceeds, a NEW LoanApplication (ENT-017) is created. This is a separate JRN-007 instance, not a continuation of the declined application.
